Subject: Redwood vs. AltServe — competitive offer and migration ask

Hi Ava,

Quick note: we just received an AltServe term sheet for a potential full vendor swap. High level: 30% off list for year 1, 3 months of reserved capacity free, and theyve offered to fund the initial migration runbook (ops hours) to accelerate cutover. Procurement attached the term sheet (AltServe_TermSheet.pdf).

Our CTO likes Redwood's runtime and the perf notes, but the CFO is pushing on economics. Can Redwood do a matching or better package? Specific asks from procurement are:
- a one-year effective discount (or credits) that nets close to their numbers
- a migration credit or assigned hours to reduce our op cost during cutover
- clarity on SLA and rollback liabilities

Would appreciate a written counter that we can take to procurement by EOD Monday. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Lucy
Director of Platform Engineering
CloudScale AI

Ava / team — here is what I recommend for a fast, defensible counter. Ive also attached a draft quote (Redwood_Offer_Quote_v3.pdf) and a short migration playbook summary we can include.

Counter package (preferred order):
1) Starter Match + Migration Credit (preferred):
   - 20% off list on inference + embeddings for year 1 (net effective concession)
   - $75,000 migration credit applied to first invoice (covers engineering runbook and 40 ops hours)
   - 3-month free reserved capacity (to mirror AltServe offering)
   - Standard SLA (99.9% uptime) with a rollback clause limited to reasonable transition support; no unusual liability carveouts

2) Deeper Year-1 Discount (if procurement insists on parity):
   - 25% off list for year 1, no migration credit but 6 months priority onboarding support (extended SRE hours)

Notes / approval:
- Option 1 can be approved by me directly from the incentives bucket up to $100k.
- Anything that increases liability or changes indemnity needs legal review and will add delay.
- If they want usage-based credits instead of percent discount, we can structure a $/token credit for the first 6 months.

Attachments included: Redwood_Offer_Quote_v3.pdf (proposal w/ line item pricing), migration_playbook_summary.docx (ops scope and hours). If Ava can push the Starter Match plus Migration Credit and DocuSign link, we should win this fast.
